0.msg: Ah, evil has returned. Will you suit up with the M-Forcers and protect the world using the power of music?

1.msg: #bOf course, but... Why do you look so haggard?#k

2.msg: You have NO IDEA what I've been through, and I really, really want to tell you...

3.msg: #b(Dr. Kim relays his woeful tale.)#k\r\nA few days ago, in the Omega Sector, I shouted like I always do for M-Force to unite against an evil robot that appeared.\r\n

5.msg: What do you mean, you can't do it?

6.msg: We're going to go pick up girls.

7.msg: And I've got a blind date.

8.msg: I'm going to a singles party to find my soul mate.

9.msg: ...\r\nHow can you guys think of romance at a time like this?! It's your duty to protect the world!

10.msg: Sure, sure, but don't you think we'd do our duty better if we weren't so lonely?

11.msg: I want someone to cuddle with, Dr. Kim!

12.msg: Just because we protect the world, doesn't mean we don't deserve love...

13.msg: #b(Dr. Kim sighs.)#k\r\nSo that's what happened. I ended up promising them we'd go on a team blind date when things weren't so busy.

14.msg: Ugh, even the developers of the Mesotron-X were complaining about wanting some time off.

15.msg: They should have thought about that before they became developers!

16.msg: #b(Is he talking about the developers of the Mesotron-X... or the developers of MapleStory? Dun, dun, dun...)#k

17.msg: I mean, I suppose it IS rather sad...

18.msg: Anyway, I've thrown in some extra fun songs to go with the original play list. This way, we can save the world and have fun at the same time. \r\n#e#b<Go Go! M-Forcer>#n#k\rPlayers: 3 to 5\rLimit: Up to 10 times a day\rRequired Level: Lv. 33+\rVictory Requirements: Press the arrow keys to the rhythm!\rRewards: #i4310108# #t4310108# #i2432306# #t2432306#

no.0: Don't be like that. At least listen to what I have to say.

yes.0: Great! Shake your booty to the music, defeat the evil robot, and save the world.\r\n#b(You can get on the M-Forcer waiting list through Dr. Kim.)#k\r\n
